from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document parsed from the collection."""
    title: str = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document")
    case_cause: str = Field(description="The case cause (案由) identified in the document")
    document_type: str = Field(description="The type of legal document (e.g., 裁定书，决定书，判决书)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
